index.html.summary: 🚀 BOOSE Project A robust Graphical Command Interpreter built in C# Get Started • API Reference • View on GitHub ⚡ What is BOOSE? BOOSE is a C# library designed to parse and execute graphical commands. It features a robust Canvas system, command factory, and variable handling, allowing users to draw shapes and perform logic programmatically. ✨ Key Features 🎨 Canvas Drawing 🔧 Command Logic 💾 Variable Storage Draw circles, rectangles, and lines with ease using the AppCanvas implementation. Includes support for If, Else, While, and For loops for complex drawing algorithms. A full variable system (AppVariable) allows you to store and manipulate data at runtime. 👩‍💻 Quick Code Example Here is how simple it is to draw a circle using the BOOSE syntax: // Initialize the factory and parser CommandFactory factory = new AppCommandFactory(); Parser parser = new Parser(factory, new StoredProgram(myCanvas)); // Execute a command parser.ParseCommand("circle 50");
